memory_update.text: Fabrinet is a useful second-order AI optics beneficiary because its value is in manufacturing throughput and optical interconnect assembly, not in headline GPU branding.

The photonics bottleneck may sit in InP wafer/device capacity rather than in the obvious transceiver labels; supplier concentration and qualification cycles are likely more important than broad industry branding.
The most obscure opportunity may be in precision substrates and receive-side devices, where analyst coverage appears thin and qualification cycles can be long.

node: Photonic components: InP lasers, photodetectors, precision substrates, and compound-semiconductor platforms
summary: This node appears to be one of the quieter AI infrastructure chokepoints: direct compound-semiconductor suppliers and photonics manufacturers sit one or two steps away from the obvious GPU story, while qualification cycles, limited supplier counts, and InP capacity constraints may create scarcity. The main context anchors are Coherent and Lumentum; the underfollowed discovery lane is better represented by Fabrinet as a second-order manufacturing beneficiary and Aeluma as a speculative small-cap platform play.
